Show one provider: its status, the scale sets on it, and its runners.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar providers inspect NAME [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Write JSON. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
